# Kentucky Powder Coating

> Heavy-industrial and custom powder coating in Maysville, Kentucky. We strip, coat, and cure metal parts — durable, color-matched finishes for industrial steel, fabrication, automotive, architectural, agricultural, and custom work. We handle large parts up to 40 feet long.

Kentucky Powder Coating (KPC) is a powder coating shop located at 679 Parker Drive, Maysville, KY 41056, serving northeastern Kentucky and the surrounding region. The business is new (established 2026). Contact: info@kentuckypc.com. Hours: Monday–Friday, 7:30 AM – 5:00 PM ET. Phone: not yet published — contact by email.

## Key facts

- Location: 679 Parker Drive, Maysville, KY 41056
- Service area: Maysville, Mason County, and northeastern Kentucky + surrounding region
- Max part length: 40 feet
- Finishes: hundreds of RAL colors; gloss, satin, matte, textured, metallic, candy/translucent; custom color matching
- Process: consult & estimate → surface prep & pretreatment (blasting, degreasing) → electrostatic powder application → cure & inspect
- Quote turnaround: typically within one business day
- Substrates: mild steel, stainless steel, aluminum, cast iron, and more

## Markets served

- Industrial & Fabrication: structural steel, weldments, skids, racks, trailers, production runs
- Automotive & Performance: frames, wheels, suspension, bumpers, restoration parts
- Architectural & Commercial: railings, gates, façade components, site furnishings
- Agricultural & Equipment: implements, attachments, heavy equipment refinishing
- Custom & Restoration: motorcycles, furniture, firearms, one-off projects
